title: Simulate cassette tape audio profiles using FFmpeg
summary: An open-source project that recreates vintage cassette tape audio characteristics using FFmpeg filters, adding effects like tape hiss, wow/flutter, frequency roll-off, and other analog artifacts to digital audio.
problem_solved: Provides an accessible way to simulate authentic cassette tape sound without expensive hardware or vintage equipment.
why_valuable: Enables musicians, game developers, and content creators to add nostalgic retro audio effects to their projects using free, open-source tools.
